plan.title: Decompose src/lib/cloister/service.ts (2039 lines) into focused modules
plan.author: agent:claude-fable-5

references.label: PRD (verified against main @ bc95c5956c; anchors re-verified at f4a43ee4a6)

narratives.Problem: src/lib/cloister/service.ts is 2,135 lines (baseline 2,135, regrowing — it reddened main on 2026-07-02 by growing past its baseline). It mixes ~580 lines of module-level reactive dispatch (domain-event → role spawn) with the ~1,425-line CloisterService class covering lifecycle, health monitoring, crash/restart/poke, completion markers (the PAN-174 verification-gate entry), alerts, and the status surface. Nothing about its structure resists growth, and it is pipeline-runtime machinery: a defect here stalls the pipeline that ships the fix (TENET-10).
narratives.Proposal: Barrel decomposition per the PRD (drafts/PAN-2149.md): service.ts keeps every export resolving via re-exports so zero importers change. Module-level reactive dispatch moves verbatim to service-reactive.ts; class-method bodies extract to service-health.ts, service-crash.ts, service-completion.ts via host-object delegation (enumerated host interfaces built as object literals at the call site — no private→public widening, no raw `this`). One seam per commit; full suite + typecheck + lint (with file-size baseline --update) per seam. The event-store provider trio stays in service.ts (only the class reads it). Final audit enforces every file <1,000 lines with an explicit fallback extraction (service-status.ts) if service.ts lands ≥1,000.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No changes to cloister/specialists.ts (PAN-2232), cloister/merge-agent.ts (PAN-2233), routes/workspaces/merge-ops.ts (PAN-2190), or cloister/deacon.ts (PAN-2189 — deliberately deferred)
- No behavior change to patrol cadence, crash policy, poke escalation, or the verification gate; no reordering of check sequences inside start()/startMonitoringLoop()/performHealthCheck()
- No conversion of CloisterService to Effect services and no dissolution of the class
- No importer/call-site edits anywhere outside src/lib/cloister/ (barrel preserves the import surface) except the sanctioned test repoints named in the plan
- No renamed exports, no logic edits, no new explicit `any`, no execSync, no file-size baseline raises

autoDecisions.summary: PRD WI-5 split into two beads (alerts-extract, final-audit) with an explicit fallback rule: if service.ts ≥1,000 lines after alerts-extract, extract getStatus/getAgentHealth/getAllAgentHealth bodies into service-status.ts.

autoDecisions.summary: Every seam commit runs `bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update` and commits the lowered baseline.
autoDecisions.rationale: Verified npm run lint includes lint:file-size, which fails on stale (shrunken) baseline entries; --update only lowers or drops entries, never raises.

autoDecisions.summary: requiresInspection is set only on the health seam (first host-delegation extraction).
autoDecisions.rationale: It establishes the host-object delegation pattern the crash, completion, and alerts seams copy; a wrong pattern there would cascade (foundation criterion). The reactive seam is a verbatim move whose defects surface at typecheck/full suite.

Extract health-monitoring method bodies to service-health.ts via host-object delegation

narrative.Action: Create src/lib/cloister/service-health.ts and extract the bodies of CloisterService.performHealthCheck (~line 1069), recordHealthEvent (~1762), mapHeartbeatSource (~1877), checkHandoffTriggers (~1802), and checkSpecialistRotations (~1739) using host-object delegation (PRD D2): each extracted function takes a host parameter typed by an interface enumerating EXACTLY the members its moved body uses (fields, and closures like emit/pokeAgent for private methods it calls) — one host interface per function or one shared HealthHost, enumerated from the moved bodies, nothing speculative. Each class method becomes a ≤5-line delegate constructing the host object literal at the call site, closing over `this`. Bodies move verbatim with `this.` → `host.`; no visibility widening; no raw `this` passed. Use `import type` for types pulled from service.ts. Baseline --update in the same commit. This bead establishes the delegation pattern the crash, completion, and alerts seams copy — it gates them via work.inspect.

narrative.Action: Closing audit of the decomposition. (1) Size: wc -l on service.ts and every service-*.ts seam — all must be under 1,000 lines. Decision rule if service.ts is ≥1,000: extract the bodies of getStatus (~line 1899), getAgentHealth (~1949), and getAllAgentHealth (~1961) into a new src/lib/cloister/service-status.ts per the established delegation pattern until service.ts is under 1,000. (2) Introspection: run tests/lib/cloister/review-agent.test.ts and confirm 'startup recovery logs gated dispatch as a deferral' passes — the matched block (~line 884, 'Re-dispatched recovery review') must still live in service.ts's start(); if any seam moved it, repoint the test's readFileSync target in this commit with assertions unweakened. Also confirm tests/unit/lib/database/agent-backfill.test.ts passes (none of its scanned runtime functions are defined in service.ts today — if that changed, add the owning seam file to its runtimePaths). (3) Cycles: npm run build must exit 0; if lint:circular reports changed cycle lines, run bash scripts/lint-circular-deps.sh --update and carry the audited additions with this issue's ref; a RUNTIME ESM cycle error in the build means stop and report, never a logic workaround. (4) Baseline: bash scripts/lint-file-size.sh --update — the service.ts entry is lowered or dropped, never raised.
